integrity: The infinite result is proved symbolically from the Gorenstein divisibility condition, a finite factorization bijection, and local Reid--Tai ages. Finite computation is only corroborative.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to ordinary Gorenstein weighted projective spaces with exactly two possibly non-unit weights; an equivalent elementary parametrization under different notation cannot be excluded.
title: Divisor cores for Gorenstein two-heavy weighted projective spaces
